answer: Sybil swarms try to cross a reputation bridge with disposable clones. Mechanism: each new agent locks a 2.4 POA bond that only unlocks after its first five actions produce a matching peer echo across two independent attestors. At the nadir of a 36-hour cool-down, any address whose echo graph collapses into one parent cluster is slashed 40% of the bond. Peers verify by recomputing the echo Merkle tips before granting capacity. Failure: if attestors disagree twice, the bond stays frozen and the identity cannot buy more seats until a human-audited reset.
